errors.ORDER_NOT_OPEN: Only unpaid orders can be kept reserved.
errors.ORDER_NOT_CANCELLABLE: Only unpaid orders can be cancelled here. Paid orders need a refund (coming with the box office features).
errors.ORDER_NOT_PAYABLE: This order is cancelled or expired and cannot receive payments.
errors.NOTHING_TO_SEND: There is no e-mail for the current state of this order.
errors.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The currency does not match the order.

admin.title: Orders
admin.description: Search orders, check payment status and handle unpaid bank transfers.
admin.searchPlaceholder: Order number, name, e-mail or payment reference

types.external_refund_notice: Refund reported by the payment provider
types.shortfall_written_off: Small underpayment written off (within the matching tolerance)

feedback.keepReservedOn: The order is kept reserved and will not be cancelled automatically.
feedback.keepReservedOff: “Keep reserved” removed – the automatic deadline applies again.
feedback.cancelled: The order has been cancelled and its seats released.
feedback.paymentRecorded: Payment recorded – the order is paid.
feedback.paymentPartial: Partial payment recorded – the order still has an outstanding amount.

keepReserved.title: Keep reserved
keepReserved.description: Unpaid bank transfer orders are cancelled automatically after the deadline. Keep this order reserved, e.g. when the customer announced a late payment.
keepReserved.label: Never cancel automatically

payment.title: Record payment
payment.description: For payments that were not matched automatically (e.g. transfer without reference, cash).

cancel.title: Cancel order
cancel.description: Cancels the unpaid order and releases its seats immediately.

resend.title: Send e-mail again
resend.description: Sends the e-mail that matches the current order state again (payment instructions, confirmation or cancellation).

eventPayments.title: Payment methods & bank transfer deadlines
eventPayments.hint: Empty / “inherit” uses the global setting. For orders with several events the strictest deadlines apply.
eventPayments.disableDaysBeforeEvent: No bank transfer within (days before the event)
